data.title: bn-1eh: independently switchable fixture authorization defects
data.description: Four default-on synthetic local fixture defects: cross-user order GET and PATCH, anonymous private report GET, and owner-primed cached report anonymous GET. Hidden Rust harness supports independent on/off tests; public modes remain bn-189 and ground-truth packaging remains M0.2.8. Full just check passes, including 22 tests; new tests cover isolation, non-mutation, cache ordering, object/app isolation, delete/reset. Review expected deliberate defects against these fixture requirements, preserving all-off behavior and unaffected policies.
